meta.title: Method overview: Growing Tree MoE for Scaffold-GS
meta.caption: Overview of our Growing Tree MoE decoder on Scaffold-GS (no GNN). SfM points initialize anchors $(x_i,f_i)$. For each view, anchors yield view features $u_i=\phi(f_i,d_i,\ldots)$. Each attribute head $h\in\{\alpha,\Sigma,c\}$ uses a Tree MoE: routers at internal nodes, experts at leaves. At Stage-B init the tree has $B=8$ root leaves warm-started 1:1 from a flat MoE; sparse Top-$k$ ($k=2$) is applied per router, and leaf probabilities are path products $\pi_i(\ell)$. Expert outputs are mixed to predict neural-Gaussian attributes, then rasterized. Training minimizes $\mathcal{L}_{rgb}$ plus MoE auxiliaries $\mathcal{L}_{op}$, $\mathcal{L}_{load}$, $\mathcal{L}_{ent}$. Optional leaf growth is omitted from this overview (see Sec.~3).
honesty_notes: Tree drawing shows Stage-B initialization (8 root leaves), not a post-growth tree.
Top-k is applied at each router over its children (k=min(2,b)), not a flat Top-2 over all leaves.
Orange/green/blue colors are schematic only; they do not map to opacity/cov/color in code.
Losses match paper Sec. 3.5; do not use the style-template paper's L_opacity+L_load alone.
Rendered vs GT shows a training view used by L_rgb (not a test-set novel view).
style_notes: Borrow layout language only (SfM → anchors → MoE panel → predictions → render/GT).
Do not copy that paper's dense/sparse/CL branch architecture.
No numbered step badges; no external legend/growth boxes.
White background; one light-blue MoE panel; thin dark arrows.

palette.color_semantics: Decorative only. Router nodes use orange; expert leaves alternate green/blue. Do not encode attribute heads by these colors.

stages.note: Stage A: train flat MoE with E=8, Top-2. Stage B: copy experts+router into B=8 root leaves; densification off (update_until=0).

training_note.text: Optional information-guided leaf growth (traffic, residual loss, feature heterogeneity; checks at 6k/10k/14k/18k; G_max=4) belongs in Sec. 3 / a supplemental figure — not Fig.1.
training_note.why: Ablations show most PSNR gain already at grows=0 (warm-start); showing a grown tree in Fig.1 would oversell growth.

        rootR((R))

        leafE5((E5))
        leafE6((E6))
        leafE7((E7))

        mix((oplus))
        warm{{"Warm-start from flat MoE E=8"}}
        rootR --> leafE0 & leafE1 & leafE4 & leafE5 & leafE6 & leafE7

        leafE2 --> topk
        leafE3 --> topk
        topk --> mix
        heads -.-> rootR
        warm -.-> rootR
